Title: Tanay's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Tanay - 12 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Pallavi - 39 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Aditya - 9 years, friend
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
4. Naira - 11 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The garden - flower beds, a mango tree

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Pallavi stands near him.]

Tanay: "Let's do something fun today."

[Tanay slips and falls.]

Tanay: "Careful!"

[Tanay trips over a stone.]

Tanay (excited): "One more time!"

[Tanay hurts his knee.]

Pallavi: "Oh wow!"

[Tanay helps Mother get up.]

Pallavi: "How beautiful!"

[Tanay sneezes loudly.]

Tanay: "I'm ready!"

[Tanay coughs.]

Pallavi (laughing): "I'm ready!"

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Tanay stands in the park. Pallavi stands near him.]

Tanay: "What a nice place."

[Tanay catches the ball.]

Tanay (softly): "I'm ready!"

[Tanay plays cricket in the park.]

Tanay (surprised): "Yes, all right."

[Tanay goes down the slide.]

Tanay (excited): "That's easy."

[Tanay plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Tanay: "Yes, all right."

[Tanay does push-ups.]

Tanay: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Tanay does yoga on a mat.]

Tanay: "I'm ready!"

Scene 3: The garden - Day

[Tanay stands in the garden. Pallavi and Aditya stand near him.]

Pallavi: "Tanay, look over here."

[Tanay waters the plants.]

Aditya: "That was fun!"

[Tanay chases a butterfly in the garden.]

Tanay (softly): "That was such a fun day!"
